content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Leavenworth

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. No prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals in Leavenworth's military, healthcare, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide framework across multiple sessions, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend from anywhere—no travel required—while maintaining your Leavenworth work and personal schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete the CAPM application, confirming your education credentials and eligibility. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Our team provides guidance on the application process to ensure accurate submission and faster approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and review sessions. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE at your convenience. Our instructors remain available to clarify complex topics before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Track your PDUs through PMI's system, then renew before your certificate expires. Ongoing learning keeps you competitive in Leavenworth's growing project-driven organizations.

fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
